create_workspace_for_meta_optimal_transp: create a Workspace instance with a Hydra config to set up ICNN models and data samplers for color transfer
pretrain_identity_on_image_pairs: pretrain the meta ICNN network so that push operations approximate identity mappings on image pairs
run_meta_learning_training_loop: run the full meta-learning training loop with dual objective and cycle regularization for color transfer
compute_dual_objective_for_samplers: compute the mean dual objective value across a list of image samplers using the trained meta ICNN
plot_color_transfer_results: plot and save a comparison image showing source images and their color-transferred results
